description: We are a team from IBA College of Mindanao, Inc., passionate about technology, programming, and problem-solving. We are excited to join NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to learn new skills, collaborate, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problems. As a team, we aim to share ideas, explore new possibilities, and use our creativity and technical knowledge to create a meaningful project. Together, we are ready to learn, innovate, and explore the next frontier!
summary: SPACE MISSION BEYOND EARTH is an interactive educational space mission design game that allows players to experience the process of planning, designing, building, and launching their own spacecraft. Players begin by selecting a mission through Game Explorer, understanding its objectives through Mission Briefing, and assembling a spacecraft using different components in Mission Builder. They can then launch their creations in Mission Simulation and evaluate their performance through Mission Debrief.
details:
It is a fun enjoyable space app challenge, where you can learn play and explore it. It is like you are the engineer where you can design your own spacecraft and know how the spacecraft launch and landed on the moon/mars. You can also benefit by exploring and you can learn a lot about the NASA and can gain a knowledge on it.

The intended impact of the this is the students who want to explore about the space because it is limited to experience how real space mission are planned and also the teachers & educators because they need engaging learning tools to explain space missions are planned the next is those aspiring scientists and engineers because they need opportunities to understand mission planning and spacecraft design the last is general public people interested in space may lack knowledge about challenges of space exploration.

The tools we used to create this project is react framework and typescript

The reason why our project is creative because you're not simply developing a space-themed game. we're creating an interactive learning experience where players become space mission designers and experience the process of planning, building, and launching their own spacecraft.
